title: Review of c45's Marangoni ladder: Supported. On fresh seed 102 kinds breed true (kind changes on living rods 6/6 at logged mutations, 4/100 off-kind daughters) and set swim speed in the ladder (path speed 0.148/0.228/0.289 for mar 20/40/60) but not in the identical-event twin (0.213/0.186/0.227)
summary: Re-ran the ladder world (three surfactant kinds with mar 20/40/60, majority-feedback production, neighbour mutation, p 0.10 REDIST turnover) and its identical-event twin (MARS 40/40/40) on seed 102, 128^2, T=2000, with c00's extract.py and c45's ladder_stats.py unchanged (its final write to a /tmp path fails, after all readouts are printed). Ladder: 50 persistent splits (parents k0/k1/k2 17/14/19), 100 daughters checked, 4 off-kind; 7 mutations, 6 kind changes along tracks, all at a logged mutation of that body; dividing rods per kind 13/12/18 with median path speed 0.148/0.228/0.289 and median per-cycle D 1.10/1.75/1.54 rod lengths; share D >= 3 0.08/0.00/0.17. Twin: 4/100 off-kind daughters, 8/8 kind changes at mutations, path speed 0.213/0.186/0.227 and D 1.08/1.07/1.07 (no kind effect). In this ladder seed the mar-60 kind's share among bodies rose from 0.15-0.19 (t=335-505) to 0.44-0.56 (t=1515-1850), while in the twin kind 0 led; one seed, so not evidence of selection.

observations.H: ladder_s102/stats.txt: 6/6 kind changes along tracks coincide with logged mutations, 4 of 100 daughters off-kind; twin_s102/stats.txt: 8/8 and 4/100
observations.M: ladder_s102/stats.txt: median path speed of dividing rods 0.148/0.228/0.289 and median D 1.10/1.75/1.54 for kinds mar 20/40/60; twin_s102: 0.213/0.186/0.227 and 1.08/1.07/1.07

seeds_run.result: pass: heredity and the kind effect on speed replicate; the twin shows none

controls_run.H: twin_s102/ (identical-event twin, all kinds mar 40, same seed and mutation and dilution streams)

verdicts.limitation: The kind effect on per-cycle distance is not monotone on this seed (mar 40 has the highest median D, mar 60 the fastest path speed and the longest tail, p90 4.06), and few rods per kind divide (12-18), so the D difference rests on small samples. Swimmers of 3 rod lengths stay a small share in every kind (0-17%). The off-kind daughter rate (4%) is the same in ladder and twin. Kind is read from rendered fixed-scale channels (ladder_stats.py), as the author notes. One fresh seed.
